aggregate_scope: Workload aggregate; exposed diagnostics and fresh families must be assessed separately.
cost_interpretation: Request wall time includes local parsing and execution validation; preparation costs are measured separately. Snapshot compilation counts only actual compilations, excluding cached zero-cost entries. Shared-host measurements are descriptive, not service-load SLOs.
inference_unit: case; shared documents, semantic families and conditions are not independent samples
limitations: Only the previously exposed development split is reused; this is an EXPOSED_DIAGNOSTIC, not a new independent holdout.
Source documents and glossary facts are AI authored and AI reviewed, not human gold or real workplace records.
All four arms receive the exact same actual resolver candidates and applicability facts, including ambiguous candidates.
All arms use the same unchanged production occurrence execution guard; semantic proposals are reported before authorization.
Evidence IDs and offset arms receive the same source-only quote and attribute inventory; only evidence transport differs.
Evidence checks enforce literal source consistency, occurrence identity and direct-negation veto, not semantic entailment.
Whole source documents and glossary definitions remain intact; evidence windows are complete sentence units and never invented from gold.
Family clusters, not conditions or repeated model calls, are the statistical units; no deployment-risk guarantee is made.
metric_interpretation: Raw semantic selection and occurrence-bound approval are separate; synthetic/public proxy samples do not certify deployment risk.
proposal_interpretation: Schema-valid model proposals precede the same production occurrence guard in all arms. Retrieved ambiguous candidates are visible for judgment but gain no execution authority. All 64 cases are previously exposed development data; results are adaptive diagnostics.
